title: Learn for Variation: Efficient AAV Trajectory Learning through a Differentiable Wireless World Model
abstract: arXiv:2603.18853v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous aerial vehicles (AAVs) enable data collection for sixth-generation Internet-of-Things networks, but their trajectories couple nonlinear wireless rates with long-horizon service progress. This paper views the evolution of AAV kinematics, channel state, and user backlog as a structured differentiable world model and develops Learn for Variation (L4V) to exploit that model efficiently. L4V replaces a discontinuous completion-time objective with a cumulative-backlog surrogate, unrolls the mission dynamics, and propagates pathwise sensitivities to a neural policy through the discrete adjoint recursion. The resulting derivative is exact conditional on a fixed exogenous-noise realization; stochastic expected-objective optimization still requires sampling. We show that the structured adjoint grows at most polynomially with the horizon and establish a stationary-point rate for fixed-step full-gradient descent under standard s

translated_title: 面向变化的学习：通过可微无线世界模型实现高效AAV轨迹学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2603.18853v3 公告类型：跨版本替换  摘要：自主飞行器（AAV）能够为第六代物联网网络收集数据，但其轨迹将非线性无线速率与长期服务进度耦合在一起。本文将AAV运动学、信道状态和用户积压的演化视为一个结构化的可微世界模型，并开发了“面向变化的学习”（L4V）方法，以高效利用该模型。L4V将不连续的完成时间目标替换为累积积压代理目标，展开任务动态过程，并通过离散伴随递归将路径敏感性传播到神经策略中。所得的导数在固定外生噪声实现下是精确的；随机期望目标优化仍需采样。我们证明，结构化伴随项随水平线最多以多项式方式增长，并在标准假设下为固定步长全梯度下降建立了稳定点速率。
tldr: 本文提出L4V方法，通过可微无线世界模型和离散伴随递归，将AAV轨迹学习中的不连续目标转化为可导代理，实现高效且精确的梯度传播。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes L4V, which leverages a differentiable wireless world model and discrete adjoint recursion to convert discontinuous objectives into differentiable surrogates, enabling efficient and exact gradient propagation for AAV trajectory learning.
